title: Constructed graph comparisons for open restriction
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring and work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of etale Λ-module sheaves. For compactifications c,d of any morphism f, define κ_graph(c,d) using sfGraphCompactificationComparison(c,d.g,d.i,id), then the derived direct-image identity and the functor left unitor. For a cartesian square a ≫ f = p ≫ j, with j and a open immersions and f,p compactifiable, let cf be the chosen compactification of f and cp=cf.ofIsPullback(sq). Define E_sq : Rp! ⋙ D(j!) ≅ D(a!) ⋙ Rf! by κ_graph(chosen(p),cp), proper/open interchange for cf.g and j, then contraction of cp.i followed by the projection k to their composite a followed by cf.i, and expansion along a,cf.i. Define λ_sq : Rf!right ⋙ La* ≅ Lj* ⋙ Rp!right as the conjugate isomorphism of E_sq under the composite open-extension and exceptional adjunctions. All comparison data are constructed, with no choice from a mere existence theorem. No qc condition on f,p,j,a is imposed. The notions are those of def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-pc-fibre-product, and thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint; the graph construction is lem-etale-unbounded-compact-support-composition.
